paite: Kuapeuh bawlhoihna it in theihna a-it hi; himahleh kuapeuh salhna hua ahai ahi.
Mihoih in TOUPA deihsakna atang ding; himahleh gitlouhna ngaihtuah mipa moh atangsak ding.
Gitlouhna in mi aphutkip kei ding; himahleh diktatna zung akisuan ngei kei ding.
Numei hoih apasal a ding in lallukhu ahi; himahleh zumhuai bawlnu aguhte ah muatna bang ahi.
Midiktat ngaihtuahna adik a; himahleh migilou thute khemna ahi.
Migilou thute sisan suah dia bukna ahi a; himahleh mitang kam in amau asuaktasak ding hi.
Migiloute zoh in a-om ua, a-om nawnta kei uh; himahleh midiktatte inn bel adingh ding hi.
Mihing apilna bangbang a phat in a-om ding; himahleh kuapeuh lungtang hoih lou muhsit in a-om ding hi.
Kuapeuh amah kingai thupi a, tanghou neiloumi sang in kuapeuh zahtak zek a om a sikha neimi ahoihzaw.
Midiktat in agan hinna alimsak hi, himahleh migilou zahngaihna nemte akhel mahmah hi.
Kuapeuh agam lei let in tanghou tampi anei ding, himahleh mi bangmah lou nungdelhmi theihsiamna bei ahi.
Migilou in migiloute len adeih a, himahleh midiktatte zung in gah asuang hi.
Mukte tatlekna ah migilou a ding in thang a-om a, himahleh buaina a kipan midiktat ahong paikhe ding.
Amuk gah in mihoih tai in a-om ding a; huan mihing khut a hihte akiang a piak ahi ding.
Mihai lampi amah mit ah adik a; himahleh kuapeuh apil in thupha angaikhia hi.
Mihai buaina tu mahmah a theih ahi; himahleh mipilvang in zahlakna asel hi.
Kuapeuh thutak gen in diktatna a-ensak a, himahleh palai zuau in khemna.
Namsau sut bang a pilvang loutak a pau a-om a; himahleh mipil lei damna ahi.
Thutak lei tangtawn in hihkip in a-om ding; himahleh lei zuauthei zaw mitphiat kal khat a ding lel ahi.
Gilou thilgelte lungtang ah khemna a-om; himahleh lemna thupha gente kiang ah nopna a-om hi.
Midiktatte tung ah siatna ahong tung kei dia; himahleh migilou, gilou in adim ding.
Muk zuautheite TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; himahleh diktak a hihte akipahna ahi uh.
Mipilvang in theihna asel a; himahleh mihai lungtang in haina apuangkhia.
Mithanuam khut in vaihawmna apo dia; himahleh mithadah khut phutluih nna sepsak ahi ding hi.
Lungtang gikna in mi akunsak a; himahleh thuhoih in akipaksak hi.
Midiktat a-inveng a ding in pitu ahi a; himahleh migilou lampi in amaute a paikhialsak hi.
Mithadah in agamvakna a amatsa nangawn a-em ngap kei a; himahleh mithanuam vanneihte amanpha hi.
Diktatna lampi ah hinna a-om; huai alampi ah sihna a-om kei hi.
